game.name: moba
game.description: PufferLib's Ocean MOBA as a Coworld: a 5v5 lane-pushing battle arena, bit-exact with the upstream training environment (same C sim compiled to wasm, same 510-byte observations and [7,7,3,2,2,2] MultiDiscrete actions). Radiant and Dire each field five heroes (support, assassin, burst, tank, carry) that push three creep-wave lanes through enemy towers to destroy the opposing Ancient. Heroes level up on experience, respawn on death, and carry three skills on cooldown. An episode ends when an Ancient falls or at the tick cap (tick-cap ties break by remaining Ancient health; equal health is a draw). Two variants: ten seats of one hero each, or two seats of five (one full team per seat). Replays re-simulate deterministically in a static wasm viewer from the recorded seed and per-tick action log.

seed.description: Deterministic sim seed. Omitted: the server derives a fresh random seed and records it in results and the replay header.

tokens.description: One connection token per player seat, indexed by seat slot. Injected by the runner; never authored.

players.description: One player display-name object per seat, indexed by seat slot. players x heroes_per_seat must equal 10: ten seats with heroes_per_seat 1, or two seats with heroes_per_seat 5.

max_ticks.description: Tick cap; reaching it ends the episode with an Ancient-health tiebreak.

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count. Used by the platform ladder service for block seating; ignored by the game server.

heroes_per_seat.description: Heroes each seat controls: 1 (ten seats, one hero each) or 5 (two seats, one full team each).

tick_deadline_ms.description: Per-tick action deadline in milliseconds; a late/missing/malformed reply plays the no-op action for that seat's heroes.

wall_clock_budget_seconds.description: Engine wall-clock hard stop: a slow episode ends itself with end_reason wall_clock (ancient-health tiebreak, artifacts written) once this much real time has elapsed. Default: min(0.9 x episode_timeout_minutes x 60, max_ticks x tick_deadline_ms / 1000) - always under the platform's episode_timeout_minutes container kill, which would lose results and replay.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for all seats to connect before starting; seats that never connect play no-op and are reported to COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI.

seed.description: The deterministic sim seed the episode ran with.

names.description: One player name per seat, in seat-slot order.

scores.description: One scalar score per seat: win 1.0, draw 0.5, loss 0.0.

winner.description: Winning team: 0 radiant, 1 dire, null draw.

dead_seats.description: Per-seat strike-rule dead flag at episode end (10 consecutive missed ticks marks a seat dead; a valid reply revives it).

end_reason.description: Why the episode ended: an Ancient fell, the tick cap was reached, the engine's wall-clock budget expired (tick_cap and wall_clock share the ancient-health tiebreak), or the sim reported an internal fault (sim_fault: no winner, draw scores, partial replay).

noop_ticks.description: Per-seat count of ticks played as the no-op fallback (late, missing, malformed, or dead seat).

agent_stats.description: Per-hero end-of-episode stats, indexed by hero pid (0-4 radiant, 5-9 dire).

noop_causes.description: Per-seat NOOP-fallback cause counters. timeout/malformed/disconnected/host_error partition noop_ticks; wrong_tick counts mis-addressed reply messages at the transport (such a tick also counts as timeout).

reward_sums.description: Per-seat sum of the sim's per-hero training rewards over the episode.

ancient_healths.description: Remaining Ancient health at episode end: [radiant, dire].

player.name: baseline
player.description: Upstream PufferLib pretrained policy (moba_weights.bin) run through the vendored puffernet forward pass compiled to wasm - the exact network the sim was trained with. Image placeholder is replaced at deploy time.

variants.name: Default (10 seats)
variants.description: Ten seats, one hero each: five independent policies per team playing the full 5v5 MOBA.

variants.name: Team (2 seats)
variants.description: Two seats, five heroes each: one policy controls a whole team, radiant vs dire.
